4.Voiding cystourethrogram (VCUG) - Criterion standard for diagnosis of vesicoureteral reflux
• ultrasound, CT and VCUG (voiding cystourethrogram). to\nconfirm urachal abnormalities.

The “bottom-up” method was a renal sonogram plus a voiding cystourethrogram (VCUG), which will identify upper and lower urinary tract abnormalities, including VUR, bladder–bowel dysfunction, andbladder abnormalities, such as a paraureteral diverticulum.
